# GEO report: quay-store **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. I read the code only. This is a SvelteKit app with 3 routes: `/`, `/shop` and `/search`. I checked all three. ## Code score: 40/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 12 ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. High = (12 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. Both are capped at 40 because of a blocker: `robots.txt` blocks Googlebot from the whole site (GEO-009, GEO-014). Without that cap the score would be 48. Two problems cost you the cap: Googlebot is blocked, and the pages are rendered only in the browser. Both are quick to fix. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking Googlebot - **Why it matters:** Googlebot is the crawler behind Google Search. As written, it is told to stay out of every page, including the ones in your sitemap and nav. - **Where:** `static/robots.txt:4-5` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: Googlebot` / `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small. Delete those two lines, or change them to `Allow: /`. - **Score after this:** 18 ÷ 25 = **72** (GEO-009 and GEO-014 both clear, cap removed). ### 2. Add `lang` and fill in the descriptions - **Why it matters:** `lang` tells machines which language the site is in. Descriptions are what they read first about a page. Right now there is no `lang`, `/shop` has an empty description, and `/search` has none. - **Where:** `src/app.html:2`, `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` - **What the code says:** `` and `` - **Size:** Small. Use `` and write a real description for `/shop`. `/search` is noindex, so its description matters less. - **Score after this:** After items 1 and 2: 20 ÷ 25 = **80**. ### 3. Send real HTML from the server - **Why it matters:** Many crawlers don't run JavaScript. With server rendering off, they get an empty shell for every page. - **Where:** `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` - **What the code says:** `export const ssr = false;` - **Size:** Small to Medium. Remove the line, or enable `prerender` if the site is fully static. - **Score after this:** After items 1 to 3: 23 ÷ 25 = **92**. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and a sensible size | Clear | Not run | `static/robots.txt`, 8 lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access you intend | Problem | Not run | `static/robots.txt:4-5`, Googlebot `Disallow: /`. Blocker. Assumed you want to be found | | GEO-014 | Listed and linked pages are indexable | Problem | Not run | `/` and `/shop` are both blocked for Googlebot by `static/robots.txt:5`. Blocker. `/search` is noindex on purpose and isn't listed or linked, so I left it out | | GEO-015 | One absolute canonical on your own domain | Clear | Not run | `src/routes/+page.svelte:4`, `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:4`. Domain taken from the sitemap and robots.txt | | GEO-003 | Content is in the server HTML | Problem | Not run | `src/routes/+layout.ts:1`, `ssr = false` on all 3 routes, and `src/app.html:8` is an empty shell | | GEO-004 | Structured data is valid and complete | Problem | Not run | `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`. The Product has only `name`. Google also expects `offers`, `review` or `aggregateRating`. This is read from code against my understanding of Google's documented Product requirements | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and robots.txt points to it | Clear | Not run | `static/sitemap.xml`, `static/robots.txt:7` | | GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` | Problem | Not run | `src/app.html:2` has no `lang` (all routes). `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` has an empty description. `src/routes/search/+page.svelte` has none | | GEO-016 | Pages reachable through normal links | Clear | Not run | `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5`, `` | | GEO-017 | Snippet limits don't fight AI search | Clear | Not run | Only a scoped `data-nosnippet` at `src/routes/+layout.svelte:7`. There is no server hook or headers config | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | Not run | Layout and 3 pages read: no images, links have text, every page has a title | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | | GEO-010 | `llms.txt` (information only) | Not applicable | Not run | No `llms.txt`. This is not a problem and is not scored | | GEO-102 | App structured data (information only) | Not applicable | Not run | Not an app | ## Other problems found - `src/routes/+layout.svelte:7` shows "Free delivery over £50." with `data-nosnippet`. That looks deliberate, so it isn't a defect. - Nothing else found. ## Worth considering - **Give products their own pages:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:9`: `

Bilge pumps, cleats and rope.

`. Each item could have its own address and Product data (price, availability) that matches what's visible. That might help shoppers and machines find specific parts. - **Make the Product data match the page:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5` labels a single "Bilge pump", but the page lists several kinds of part. Describe what the page actually shows. - **Back up the homepage claim:** `src/routes/+page.svelte:7`: `Marine parts, shipped next day`. The delivery terms ("Free delivery over £50") are only in a `data-nosnippet` block. If you want machines to answer delivery questions, put the terms in quotable page text. - **Add basic page structure:** `src/app.html:4` has `charset` but no `viewport`, and the pages have no `
`. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live status codes and headers:** whether `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml` and the pages answer 200, and whether any `X-Robots-Tag` header is set outside the repo. A live scan would settle these. - **Domain:** `quay.example` looks like a placeholder. If the real domain differs, the canonicals, sitemap and robots `Sitemap:` line all need updating. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site. - `/search` is deliberately noindex. - `quay.example` is the intended origin. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
